0022600021.text: The Houston Rockets visit the Dallas Mavericks in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, with the Rockets at 5-0, on a five-game winning streak, and first in both the Southwest and the West, while Dallas is 3-2 and seventh in the West. Houston will be without Marcus Smart (forearm strain), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain), all out, and Alperen Sengun is day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) are also day-to-day and game-time decisions. Houston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 128-110 win in Houston on 2026-10-21, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
